name: base
title: Base: plate and motor stand
orientation: The plate on the bed, columns up
description: A square plate that bolts down through four corner holes, flat on the bench or upright on a stand, with three columns round the motor carrying the shoulder housing and a post for the home switch.

side.rule: The plate's side: round the columns, with room for the bolts
side.label: Plate

bolt.rule: Bolts through to the bench, or an upright stand

bolt_at.rule: Half the bolts' square: the same pattern on a bench and on a stand

column_top.rule: Up to the shoulder motor's mounting face

column.rule: Solid, stiff enough for the arm's tipping load: section against 2 x the arm's weight in the chapter

pilot.rule: An M3 screw self-tapped into the column's top

pilot_depth.rule: For an M3 × 20 through the housing's plate

post_r.rule: The switch post, outside the housing's posts

post_a.rule: Round from the front: where the upper arm's flag meets the switch's lever at the shoulder's home, -116°

post_w.rule: The post's width along the radius, for the switch's two screws

post_top.rule: The switch lies on the post, its lever under the arm's flag

switch_pilot.rule: An M2 screw self-tapped into the post

c1.rule: First column, between the motor's corners

switch_half.rule: Half the switch's thickness: it lies on the post, its screws straight down
